critical_citations.section: Section 4.5: Spindle Vibration & Cutting Insert Diagnostics
critical_citations.snippet: When vertical scratches (scratch_vertical) appear on finished Face A accompanied by spindle vibration increase (> 35% above baseline or RMS > 4.5 mm/s) and current elevation (+10% to +15%), the primary root cause is cutting tool insert flank wear or edge chipping on active cutter T07.
Spindle runout tolerance TIR <= 0.005 mm (5.0 µm). Measured runout > 0.005 mm causes asymmetric chip loading, harmonic chatter, and surface scratches.

critical_citations.section: Section 4.2: Standard Automotive Transmission Housing Tooling Layout
critical_citations.snippet: Tool station T07 (Face Mill Ø50, 4-Flute APMT1604PDER-M2) manufacturer rated life limit is 2,000 parts.

page_anchors.2: Historical Maintenance Timeline & Cumulative Tool Usage

critical_citations.section: Historical Maintenance Timeline & Cumulative Tool Usage
critical_citations.snippet: Tool T07 ran 2,400 parts against manufacturer limit of 2,000 parts under calendar-based SOP-MNT-CNC-04. Flank wear measured VB = 0.38 mm with chipped edge on pocket 2.
Replaced all 4 inserts with fresh APMT1604PDER-M2. Torqued to 3.5 N·m. Dial indicator runout measured 0.003 mm (< 0.005 mm threshold). 50/50 consecutive parts verified defect-free.

documents.title: 8D Incident Report: CNC-02 Spindle Vibration Spike & Machined Face Scratching

page_anchors.1: D1: Team Establishment & D2: Problem Description
page_anchors.4: D5: Permanent Corrective Action (PCA) & D6: Verification

critical_citations.snippet: Prior incident on 2026-03-12 where spindle vibration was cured by insert replacement on tool T07, torquing to 3.5 N·m, and confirming runout 0.003 mm < 0.005 mm.
Root cause chain confirmed: vertical scratches -> chipped insert -> spindle vibration -> tool exceeded 2,000 cycle life limit -> calendar-based SOP lacked cycle counter interlock.

page_anchors.32: Chapter 2: Raw Material Properties — ABS Resin Processing

critical_citations.section: Chapter 2: Raw Material Properties — ABS Resin Processing
critical_citations.snippet: ABS resin processing moisture limit is <= 0.02% by weight (200 ppm). Moisture > 0.02% causes steam vaporization, leading to sink marks (sink_mark) and short fill (short_fill).
Desiccant honeycomb dryer nominal dew point is -40 °C. Warning threshold is -30 °C. Critical failure limit is -18 °C. Minimum pre-drying requirement is 4 hours at 80-85 °C.

documents.title: Tooling Specification & Rheological Analysis: 4-Cavity Enclosure Mold (MOLD-E4C-05)

page_anchors.2: Hydraulic Runner Length & Flow Resistance Analysis

critical_citations.section: Hydraulic Runner Length & Flow Resistance Analysis
critical_citations.snippet: Cavity #3 runner length is 285 mm compared to 180 mm for Cavity 1 and Cavity 2 (+26% higher pressure drop), causing highest flow resistance and melt cooling.
When ABS moisture exceeds 0.02%, Cavity #3 is the first to exhibit sink marks and short fill due to its 285 mm runner length while other cavities remain visually acceptable.

documents.title: Auxiliary Equipment Maintenance Log: Dehumidifier Dryer-03

critical_citations.snippet: Dryer-03 dew point drifted from -40 °C to -18 °C at 13:50 on 2026-10-07. New damp resin lot ABS-20261007-B introduced at 14:00 resulted in sink marks on Cavity #3 at 14:20.
Clogged intake filter cartridge FLT-DM-04 choked desiccant airflow. Swapped filter, regenerated dryer to -41.5 °C dew point, re-dried resin for 4 hours to 0.011% moisture.

documents.title: 8D Incident Report: IM-05 Cavity 3 Sink Marks & Clogged Dryer Intake Filter

page_anchors.1: D1: Team Establishment & D2: Problem Description
page_anchors.4: D5: Permanent Corrective Action (PCA) & D6: Verification

critical_citations.snippet: Replaced clogged filter cartridge FLT-DM-04, restored dew point to -41 °C, re-dried resin for 4 hours to 0.012% moisture. 50 consecutive shots (200 parts) verified defect-free.

Root cause: Clogged intake filter on Dryer-03 choked airflow -> dew point climbed to -18 °C -> ABS resin pellet moisture reached 0.045% (> 0.02% threshold) -> Cavity #3 runner length (285 mm) suffered localized pressure drop.
